title: Revit modeling construct selection and hygiene
test_intent: Determine whether groups, assemblies, linked models, and workshared model structures are being used for their governed purpose without over-grouping, excessive nesting, circular links, or uncontrolled model partitioning.

applicability.applies_when: The tested scope contains model groups, assemblies, linked Revit models, or governed workshared model partitioning.
applicability.not_applicable_when: None of these constructs are present in the tested scope.

required_evidence: link graph and model breakdown record
applicable S5/S6 model partitioning and linking strategy
documented project-specific exception or rationale where applicable

result_logic.pass: Groups and assemblies match their governed repetition/documentation purpose, unmanaged deep nesting or whole-model grouping is absent, link structure is directed and non-circular, and model partitioning follows the governed project strategy.
result_logic.fail: A positive violation is found, including uncontrolled over-grouping, problematic deep nesting, circular links, unmanaged nested links entering governed containers, or a model-breakdown pattern that contradicts available S5/S6 rules.
result_logic.not_applicable: No governed modeling construct in scope requires evaluation.
result_logic.indeterminate: The project model-breakdown, linking, or construct-purpose rules needed for evaluation are unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E ATS for group/assembly/model-structure hygiene. Project-specific model breakdown remains governed project data.
